{"description":"A content-addressed store for what the graph cannot hold inline — session transcripts, mermaid diagrams, HTML mockups, user-supplied drawings and photographs, and the source documents a corpus was extracted from. The graph records a CONTENT HASH; the bytes live in the store; an unresolvable pointer fails loud and names itself rather than rendering a design quietly missing its pictures.

HAND-ROLLED AND SYNCHRONOUS, IN `reflow2-core` (`dec:content-store-implementation`). `put(bytes) -> hash`, `get(hash) -> bytes`, `exists(hash)` over `sha2` (already a core dependency) and `std::fs`. Zero new crates, no async runtime, deterministic and testable without one. `object_store` was measured and recorded as the documented UPGRADE PATH rather than adopted: 36 crates new to reflow2, ~24 of them URL/ICU machinery a local store never calls, buying a feature set — paths, prefixes, listing, multipart, conditional writes — that immutable content addressing does not have.

THREE PROPERTIES THE BUILD MADE REAL, each pinned by a test and two of them mutation-checked. (1) `get` VERIFIES the bytes against the hash they are stored under and REFUSES a mismatch rather than returning it — a content hash nobody checks is only a filename, and the claim that a blob fetched from anywhere can be trusted once it verifies rests entirely on this. (2) A hash is interpolated into a path, so anything that is not exactly `sha256:` plus 64 lowercase hex is refused BEFORE it reaches the filesystem; `../../etc/passwd` is a malformed hash, not a missing file. (3) Writes are temp-then-rename within the shard directory, so a process that dies mid-write leaves nothing or a whole blob — and a stranded temp file is unreachable as content because its name is not a hash.

Blobs are COMMITTED to the repo, so they travel exactly as the design does (`dec:where-content-lives`). Reading INTO stored content is not this capability's job and never becomes one — the agent navigates, the graph records an opaque locator reflow2 never parses (`dec:agent-navigates-content`). REALIZED, `ver:content-store` passing.","is_entry_point":false,"is_exit_point":false,"name":"Store bytes beside the design and point at them by content hash","provenance":"authored","status":"realized","tier":"operational"}
